title: One Temple Shaped Half of Kung Fu — Shaolin, Born 495 AD · 少林 | China Travel Expert
description:
One temple shaped half of Chinese martial arts — and half of Zen.

Shaolin Temple was founded in 495 AD at the foot of Mount Song in Henan, under Northern Wei Emperor Xiaowen. The monk Bodhidharma is honored here as the first patriarch of Chan — the tradition the West calls Zen. Monks took up martial training to survive long hours of meditation, and Shaolin kung fu was born. A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2010, the temple has been alive for roughly 1,500 years.

🧭 Expert Tip: Come before 8am to catch the warrior-monk demonstration before the tour crowds arrive.
